'''Conrad:''' {{legend0|#7996e2|50–60%}} {{legend0|#6674de|60–70%}} {{legend0|#584cde|70–80%}}
'''Clayburgh:''' {{legend0|#E27F7F|50–60%}} | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Kent Conrad]] | before_party = North Dakota Democratic-NPL Party | after_election = [[Kent Conrad]] | after_party = North Dakota Democratic-NPL Party }} {{ElectionsND}} The '''1994 United States Senate election in North Dakota''' was held on November 8, 1994. Incumbent [[North Dakota Democratic NPL Party|Democratic-NPL]] U.S. Senator [[Kent Conrad]] won re-election to his first full term as [[Seniority in the United States Senate|senior Senator]], although technically his second term in the position, having served the end of [[Quentin Burdick]]'s term after his death.
